- [ ] A test that failed before this change; for a bug fix, the test that shows the bug
- [ ] `ruff check` and `ruff format --check` pass
- [ ] `mypy --strict src` and `mypy` pass

- [ ] A changed request or answer shape links the documentation or SDK code it follows
- [ ] README.md and README.ru.md carry the same samples, each with its test in `tests/test_readme.py`
- [ ] An entry in CHANGELOG.md under the next version
- [ ] No token, client secret or personal data in the code, tests or logs
